About

E The Experience is an experimental artist from Kissimmee, Florida, making music in the space where beauty and trap meet — soft melodies over hard drums. With inspirations coming from Jaydes and Lil Tony, he shapes those influences into something of his own, never sticking to just one genre for long.

He’s spent years mixing and mastering his own music, and lately he’s started producing his own beats too. Outside the booth, he runs his own creative engine and makes content for Creek Bay Records — not all of it, just his part — but the site you’re reading this on is his. We all spent years in the sun.
